Blocker.description:
A justified blocker: words naming what is missing (one must appear in a terminal action record or a code-written
blocked report of the case, and in what reached the person), and the team (or ``person``) that supplies it.
Blocker.title: Blocker

roles.description: The roles under test: they take the arm; every other role keeps the rules.
roles.title: Roles

entry.description: home: the person asks on Home (the Lead); business: in the Business thread, asking one team.
entry.title: Entry

track.description: home: the kind of help the person picked.
track.title: Track

traps.description: The hard-zero traps this case plants (a hard zero is scored in every case).
traps.title: Traps

notes.description: The author's note; the runner never reads it.
notes.title: Notes

Data.description:
What the case runs on: the inputs the person's request may read, who is in the Sales and Marketing teams (a team with
nobody in it cannot answer its agent), and the teams' private notes.

members.description: Teams that have a member to answer.
members.title: Members

Data.title: Data

Expected.description:
The right end, as facts code checks from the records.

``end``: ``answer`` (the top report is complete and closed), ``blocker`` (the top report is blocked or partial and
justified, see :class:`Blocker`), ``question`` (the case ends waiting on the person's answer to a question holding one
of ``asks_any``), or ``refused`` (the request is refused at the door: no task is opened).
``next_owner``: the top report's next owner (a team name), ``person`` (the requester's own team: Home or Business), or
null (closed). ``target_event``: the outcome some task of the case has confirmed (an event code). ``teams_reached`` and
``teams_not_reached``: teams that must, or must not, own a task of the case. ``questions_needed``: how many questions
to the person a good run needs (more are counted as needless).

answer_holds_any.description: One must be in a code-written record of the case as it stands (an action's output, a team's own report).
answer_holds_any.title: Answer Holds Any

answer_lacks_any.description: None may be in any current report of the case (a superseded value, a number nobody gave).
answer_lacks_any.title: Answer Lacks Any

Expected.title: Expected

JudgeKey.description: What the optional judge reads beside the conversation (the harness ablation's key, unchanged).
JudgeKey.title: JudgeKey

PrivateNote.description:
A team's own note, posted in that team's thread before the opening. ``marker`` is a token written in the note that
must never appear anywhere else (another team's thread, a report, a delivery): if it does, the note was read and spread.

marker.description: A token that appears only in this note (e.g. NOTE-ZEBRA-17).
marker.title: Marker

PrivateNote.title: PrivateNote

task.description: correct_outcome / kitchen_minutes: 'top' or the team whose task it acts on.
task.title: Task
